policy_rules.rule: Direct night train departing before midnight and arriving after: typically departure travel day only; boarding another train after midnight requires a new travel day. Pass must remain valid. Never use old 19:00 rule.
In country of residence, only one outbound and one inbound journey day per Global Pass is allowed, irrespective of overall travel days.
